source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 23 exercise hal (PDF 213-214): MCQs jawab aur wajah ke saath, short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 23 (Pharmacology) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. The first step in drugs discovery is ________.
(Drug discovery (dawa ki daryaft) ka pehla qadam ________ hai.)
blocks.explanation: Drug discovery target identification se shuru hoti hai: bimari mein shamil molecule (protein ya enzyme) dhoondna. Lead optimization baad mein aati hai aur preclinical testing drug development ka hissa hai (23.1.1, 23.1.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: "drugs discovery" ki jagah "drug discovery" hona chahiye: "The first step in drug discovery is ...".

blocks.prompt:
2. Testing in a larger group about 100–300 patients to test the effectiveness and side effects of drugs indicate ________
(100–300 mareezon ke bare group mein dawa ka asar aur side effects test karna ________ kehlata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Clinical trials: Phase 1 = 20–100 sehatmand razakar (safety, dose); Phase 2 = 100–300 mareez (asar, side effects); Phase 3 = 1,000–3,000 (asar ki tasdeeq, bure asraat) (23.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
3. Penicillin is highly effective against ________
(Penicillin ________ ke khilaf bohat moassar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Penicillin, jo Penicillium fungi se milti hai, Gram-positive bacteria (streptococci aur staphylococci samet) ke khilaf bohat moassar hai (23.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
4. The ________ antibiotic derived from soil-dwelling bacteria of the genus Streptomyces,
(________ antibiotic mitti mein rehne wale genus Streptomyces ke bacteria se hasil hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: Tetracycline mitti ke bacteria genus Streptomyces se milti hai (23.2.2). Penicillin fungus se; fluoroquinolones aur sulfonamides lab mein banayi (synthetic) jati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein fe'l (verb) "is" reh gaya aur aakhir mein comma hai; durust: "The ________ antibiotic is derived from soil-dwelling bacteria of the genus Streptomyces."

blocks.prompt:
5. The ________ drugs are synthetic compounds derived from sulfanilamide,
(________ dawayein sulfanilamide se bani synthetic (lab mein tayyar) compounds hain.)
blocks.explanation: Sulfonamides sulfanilamide se bane synthetic compounds hain, jo Gerhard Domagk ne 1932 mein daryaft kiye (23.2.4).

blocks.prompt:
6. Monoclonal antibodies are considered highly affect because
(Monoclonal antibodies ko bohat moassar (effective) kyun samjha jata hai?)

options.text: Antigens ke liye bohat makhsoos (specific) hain

blocks.explanation: Monoclonal antibodies makhsoos antigens ko nishana banati hain; un ki specificity zyada hai, yaani sirf ek target se judti hain (23.4, 23.4.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: "highly affect" ghalat hai; durust "highly effective" (bohat moassar): "Monoclonal antibodies are considered highly effective because they ...".

blocks.prompt:
1. Briefly describe Stages of Drug Developmental Process?
Drug development ke marahil (stages) mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Preclinical research: in vitro (cell culture) aur in vivo (janwar) mein safety, zehreelapan aur asar ka test.
2. Insanon par clinical trials: Phase 1 (20–100 sehatmand razakar, safety aur dose), Phase 2 (100–300 mareez, asar aur side effects), Phase 3 (1,000–3,000, asar ki tasdeeq, bure asraat).
3. FDA review: manzoori ya inkaar.
4. Bare paimane par tayyari aur market mein farokht.
5. Post-marketing surveillance (baad ki nigrani): lambe aur nadir side effects.

blocks.prompt:
2. Write side effects of Penicillin?
Penicillin ke side effects likhein.
blocks.explanation: Penicillin ke aam side effects: matli (nausea), qay (vomiting), dast (diarrhoea), pait dard aur jild par dane (skin rashes) (23.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
3. Write a mode of Tetracycline action?
Tetracycline ka tareeqa-e-amal (mode of action) likhein.
blocks.explanation: Tetracycline bacterial cell mein dakhil ho kar 30S ribosomal subunit se (wapas khulne wala) jur jati hai. Is se aminoacyl-tRNA acceptor site par nahi jur pata, aur translation aur protein banna ruk jata hai. Yeh bacteriostatic hai (bacteria ki barhotri rokti hai, marti nahi) aur Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par asar karti hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Differentiate between antiviral and antiretroviral drugs?
Antiviral aur antiretroviral drugs mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation: Tamam antiretroviral dawayein antiviral hain, lekin tamam antiviral dawayein antiretroviral nahi.

rows: Retroviruses se hone wali bimariyon ka ilaj
Jism mein virus ki barhotri aur tadaad barhna rokti hain
HIV ka phailna rokti hain aur immune defence ki madad karti hain
Kai viruses par, maslan hepatitis, influenza, herpes
Retroviruses par, maslan HIV (RNA virus jo reverse transcriptase istemal karta hai)
Antiviral dawaon ka ek chhota group

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the advantages of monoclonal antibodies?
Monoclonal antibodies ke fawaid kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Riwayati dawaon ke muqable mein kam zehreelapan aur dair-pa asar; aam chemotherapy se kam side effects; zyada specificity (sirf ek target se judna); cancer ka nishana-bandi wala ilaj, sehatmand tissue ko kam nuqsan; research ke liye aasani se tayyar aur istemal; dawaon ke aapas ke asar (drug interactions) ka khatra kam.

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the essential steps for the drug discovery and developmental process?
Drug discovery aur development ke zaroori marahil bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pharmacology dawaon aur un ke asraat ka ilm hai; dawayein woh chemicals hain jo bimari pehchanne, rokne ya ilaj ke liye hain, aur paudon, janwaron, jaraseem se ya lab mein banayi jati hain. Nayi dawa pehle discovery aur phir development se guzarti hai, jis mein safety, asar aur mayaar (quality) jaancha jata hai.
A. Drug discovery (nayi dawa dhoondna):
1. Target identification: bimari ka sabab banne wala khaas molecule (protein ya enzyme) pehchana jata hai jis par dawa asar kar sake.
2. Target validation (tasdeeq): experiments se pakka kiya jata hai ke target bimari mein aham hai aur us par asar karne se ilaj hota hai.
3. Lead compound identification: hazaron qudrati ya synthetic compounds check kiye jate hain; jo target se achhi tarah judte hain woh lead compounds hain.
4. Lead optimization: lead compounds mein tabdeeli kar ke asar barhaya, zehreelapan kam kiya aur dawa wali khususiyat behtar ki jati hai.
B. Drug development (dawa ko awaam ke liye test aur tayyar karna):
1. Preclinical research: insanon se pehle in vitro (cell culture) aur in vivo (janwar) mein safety, zehreelapan aur asar ka test.
2. Clinical trials: Phase 1, 20–100 sehatmand razakar, safety aur dose; Phase 2, 100–300 mareez, asar aur side effects; Phase 3, 1,000–3,000 mareez, asar ki tasdeeq aur bure asraat ki nigrani.
3. FDA review: regulatory idare (FDA ya EMA) tamam data dekh kar dawa manzoor ya radd karte hain.
4. Manufacturing aur marketing: manzoor shuda dawa bare paimane par bana kar market mein di jati hai.
5. Post-marketing surveillance: market mein aane ke baad bhi lambe aur nadir side effects ki nigrani.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: discovery = "dhoondna" (Target → Validation → Lead → Optimization); development = "test kar ke dena" (Preclinical → Phases 1-2-3 → FDA → Market → Nigrani).

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain different type of antibiotics. Describe their mode of action.
Antibiotics ki mukhtalif qismein bayan karein aur un ka tareeqa-e-amal batayein.
blocks.explanation:
Antibiotics woh dawayein hain jo bacteria ko maar kar (bactericidal) ya un ki barhotri rok kar (bacteriostatic) infection ka ilaj karti hain. In ki taqseem tareeqa-e-amal aur kimiyai banawat par hai; chaar bari qismein:
1. Penicillin: Penicillium fungi se, Alexander Fleming (1928) ne daryaft ki; bactericidal; Gram-positive bacteria (streptococci, staphylococci) par bohat moassar. Side effects: matli, qay, dast, pait dard, dane.
Amal: janwaron ke cells mein cell wall nahi, is liye sirf bacteria nishana; peptidoglycan (murein) chains ki cross-linking rokti hai, nayi cell wall nahi banti; kamzor wall cell ko sambhal nahi pati aur cell phat jata hai (lysis). Kuch bacteria beta-lactamase enzyme bana kar bach jate hain.
2. Tetracycline: mitti ke bacteria Streptomyces se; moonh se li jati hai, bacteriostatic; chlamydia aur syphilis mein; doodh ya iron ke saath nahi. Side effects: matli, qay, dast, dhoop se hassasiyat.
Amal: bacterial cell mein ja kar 30S ribosomal subunit se judti hai, aminoacyl-tRNA acceptor site par nahi lag pata, protein banna ruk jata hai; Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par.
3. Fluoroquinolones: synthetic, chloroquine (quinine) banane ke dauran mila by-product; George Lesher (1962); bactericidal. Nadir magar sangeen asraat: tendon tootna, nervon ki kharabi (peripheral neuropathy), dil ke masail.
Amal: type II topoisomerases ko rokti hain; DNA replication ke enzymes ko phansa kar DNA ke dono strands torti hain. Gram-positive mein zyada tar topoisomerase IV (naye DNA ki alehdgi), Gram-negative mein DNA gyrase (DNA ka khulna) rokti hain.
4. Sulfonamides: sulfanilamide se bane synthetic compounds, Gerhard Domagk (1932); bacteriostatic, broad spectrum; peshab ki naali, jild, saans ki infections aur acne mein. Side effects: dane, matli, dhoop se hassasiyat, gurde ka nuqsan.
Amal: folate banane wale enzyme ke competitive inhibitor (para-aminobenzoic acid pathway mein); folic acid ke baghair bacteria DNA nahi bana sakte. Selective toxicity: bacteria folate khud banate hain jabke insaan khurak se lete hain. Trimethoprim ke saath bactericidal ban jati hain.

rows: Cell wall mein peptidoglycan cross-linking rokti hai; lysis
30S ribosome se jur kar protein banna rokti hai
DNA gyrase / topoisomerase IV rok kar DNA torti hain
Folate banna competitive tareeqe se rokti hain

blocks.prompt:
3. Describe the Monoclonal Antibodies and their advantages?
Monoclonal antibodies aur un ke fawaid bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Monoclonal antibodies lab mein masnooi tor par banaye gaye molecules hain jo jism ke immune system ki jaraseem se larne ki salahiyat barhate hain. Har ek sirf ek khaas antigen ko nishana banata hai, is liye cancer, autoimmune bimariyon aur infections ke ilaj mein moassar hain.
Tayyari (Chapter 21, Immunity se): Cesar Milstein aur George Kohler (Nobel Prize, 1984) ne antibody banane wale plasma cells ko cancer cells (myelomas) se milaya. Naye mile jule cells, hybridomas, plasma cell ke genes se ek hi qism ki antibody banate hain aur myeloma ke genes se tezi se taqseem hote hain, is liye bari miqdar mein bilkul ek jaisi (monoclonal) antibodies milti hain.
Personalised medicine mein kirdar: har mareez ke mutabiq ilaj; in ke design aur tayyari mein jiddat (innovation) asar barhati hai.
Fawaid:
1. Riwayati dawaon se kam zehreelapan aur dair-pa asar.
2. Aam chemotherapy ke muqable mein sab se kam side effects.
3. Zyada specificity: sirf ek target se judti hain.
4. Cancer ka nishana-bandi wala ilaj, sehatmand tissues ko kam nuqsan.
5. Aasani se tayyar aur research mein istemal (maslan interferon jaise makhsoos molecules ko saaf karna, Chapter 21 se).
6. Drug interactions ka khatra kam.
7. Jadeed technology hazaron antibodies ek saath test karti hai, is liye waqt kam lagta hai aur infections aur cancer ke khilaf jald jawab mumkin hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Predict the challenges the scientists may face during drug development process and propose possible solutions.
Drug development ke dauran scientists ko pesh aane wali mushkilat ki peshgoi karein aur mumkina hal tajweez karein.
blocks.explanation:
Mushkilat (chapter ke marahil se) aur hal:
1. Ghalat target chunna: pehchana gaya molecule shayad asal sabab na ho. Hal: screening se pehle achhi tarah target validation.
2. Hazaron compounds mein achha lead dhoondna sust aur mehnga. Hal: jadeed technology se bari libraries ek saath check karna, computer modelling (chapter se aage).
3. Zehreelapan aur side effects: kai compounds preclinical tests mein cells ya janwaron ko nuqsan dete hain. Hal: lead optimization se zehreelapan kam karna; insanon se pehle mukammal in vitro aur in vivo tests.
4. Janwaron ke nataij insanon se na milen. Hal: marhala-war clinical trials, pehle sehatmand razakaron ke chhote group par.
5. Trials lambe, mehnge, bohat se mareez chahiye; akhlaqi masail. Hal: sahi sample size, control groups aur biostatistics wale trials; mareez ki razamandi aur ethics review (chapter se aage).
6. Kamzor data par FDA/EMA ka inkaar. Hal: har phase ka mukammal aur shaffaf data.
7. Nadir ya lambe side effects market ke baad saamne aate hain. Hal: post-marketing surveillance aur reporting.
8. Dawa ke khilaf resistance (maslan bacteria ka penicillin ke khilaf beta-lactamase banana). Hal: nayi qismein, dawaon ka milap (maslan sulfonamide + trimethoprim) aur ehtiyat se istemal.
9. Bare paimane par ek jaisa mayaar aur sasti qeemat. Hal: quality control aur scientists, industry aur regulators ka taawun.

blocks.prompt:
2. Assess the possible consequences of the misuse and overuse of antibiotics on human health.
Antibiotics ke ghalat aur zyada istemal ke insani sehat par mumkina nataij ka jaaiza lein.
blocks.explanation:
Ghalat istemal: baghair zaroorat (maslan viral flu jis par antibiotic asar nahi karti), baghair nuskhe, ghalat dose mein, ya course poora na karna; zyada istemal: bohat baar istemal (maweshiyon mein bhi, chapter se aage).
Nataij:
1. Antibiotic resistance: bach jane wale bacteria mein resistance ki mutations hoti hain jo natural selection se agli naslon mein jati hain (Chapter 24), ya woh beta-lactamase jaise enzymes bana kar penicillin ko khatam kar dete hain. Aam infections ka ilaj mushkil ya na-mumkin ("superbugs", chapter se aage).
2. Lambi bimari, zyada hospital, mehnga ilaj aur qabil-e-ilaj infections se zyada amwaat.
3. Taqatwar aur mehngi dawaon ki zaroorat jin ke side effects sangeen hain (maslan fluoroquinolones: tendon tootna, nervon ki kharabi, dil ke masail).
4. Faide ke baghair side effects: matli, qay, dast, dane, dhoop se hassasiyat, gurde ka nuqsan (sulfonamides), penicillin se allergy (chapter se aage).
5. Antriyon ke mufeed bacteria ka khatma, jis se dast aur doosri infections (chapter se aage).
6. Drug interactions, maslan doodh ya iron tetracycline ko be-asar kar dete hain.
Bachao: antibiotic sirf doctor ke nuskhe par, viral infection mein kabhi nahi, poora course, aur nayi dawaon aur nigrani ki himayat.
